clue.text: Unusually nice? It merits ban, perhaps, Mr Straw?

explanation.surface: A sardonic question about a politician who was apparently being nice for once, and whether that deserves a ban.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack Straw was a senior member of Tony Blair's government when this was set, Home Secretary and then Foreign Secretary.
explanation.definitionFit: Jack Straw held senior posts in the British government, so he is one example of a person serving in the cabinet.

clue.text: Ordinary street and a road

taken as written
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: A scar is the lasting mark left on skin after a wound heals, so it is a type of mark.

clue.text: Heads of college order report, doubting your dodgy material

explanation.definitionFit: Corduroy is a ribbed cotton fabric, so it is a kind of cloth or textile used for clothing.
